name: Sky Atmosphere
definition: An Earth-like atmosphere model that bakes single-scattered sunlight (Rayleigh, Mie, and ozone scattering) into an equirectangular map sampled by environment_light, with sun irradiance attenuated by air along its direction.
summary: Sky Atmosphere is a physically based Earth-like model that bakes Rayleigh, Mie, and ozone scattering into an equirectangular map, distinguishing itself by explicitly modeling spectral attenuation rather than relying on precomputed textures.
